title: Open on the current roster night
summary: Night now follows Malta time and stays on the current roster night until the next roster night actually begins, instead of jumping ahead to a future roster date.
changes: Opening Night now selects the current roster night from the Malta clock rather than the next future rostered date.
The current roster night remains selected between roster dates and changes automatically only when the next roster night reaches its 19:00 start boundary.
Across midnight and the early-morning duty window, the same roster night remains selected so 00:00–07:00 live timing and handover tracking stay attached to the correct night.
The date control now labels the automatically selected date as Current roster night and no longer calls a future date current simply because it was auto-selected.
The app rechecks this clock rule every minute and whenever it becomes visible, while manual browsing remains respected until the user returns to Current night.
